security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI writes mseccfg.MSSE=1 to enable M-mode shadow stack, but mseccfg.RLB=0 and at least one PMP entry has pmpcfg.L=1, causing the MSSE write to be silently ignored per spec. OpenSBI then executes shadow stack instructions (sspush/sspopchk) assuming SSE enforcement is active, but no CFI protection is actually applied.
security_spec.summary: Silent mseccfg.MSSE write failure when RLB=0 with locked PMP entries disables M-mode shadow stack enforcement, breaking assumed backward-edge CFI
